hypothesis_source: AI reading the causal detector and the existing failed-breakout autopsy; development data, not independent discovery
baseline: 2034 independent cup fills: dual regime AND RS>=85 AND upper-half signal close; mean net +0.54%
change: Keep only previous market-session close <= signal-day reconstructed cup pivot < signal-day close. This is a crossing event, with no parameter search or change of pivot offset.
execution: Subset of the complete frozen independent fills, same next-market-open entry, original exit, T+1 and original historical costs. No new or delayed entries. Missing previous market bar or pivot fails closed and is reported.
training: 2016-2022, original exit within 2022; load no bars after 2022
exposure: Earlier experiments and 2023+ exposed; source run contains no validation trades. No clean OOS claim.
initial_gate: At least 100 trades, positive mean net strictly better than baseline, signal-day equal-weight actual net not worse than baseline. Otherwise drop this representation and its crossing-buffer neighbours.
passing_action: Research candidate only: verify complete opportunity execution and fixed-window comparisons before any promotion or product change.
artifacts: analysis JSON, decision Markdown; per-trade selection ledger under data/research/cup-handle/
